_comment: First-party Applied Energistics 2 compat (AE2PLAN #18d) — a small, FINITE certus deposit on the rocky mining island: ae2:quartz_block (the inert 'Certus Quartz Block'; deconstructs shapeless → 4 certus crystals). This is the GATE INGREDIENT the meteorite-island seed recipe consumes — you must mine certus in normal play before you can grow the AE2 island — NOT a functional AE2 supply: certus alone builds no storage (that needs the meteorite island's sky stone + inscriber presses). Modern AE2 has no certus ore, so the inert quartz_block is the deposit block (full solid cube — no attachment/placement issue like quartz_cluster). Inert without AE2 (unknown block skipped before any RNG → byte-identical). Bands merge into rocky's snowy / min_y:130 / max_y:8 / min_y:70 bands (selectors match rocky.json) so certus doesn't vanish on low/high throws, per quark_rocky.json / immersiveengineering_rocky.json. Base-density counts (OrePlanner scales by volume). Mirror to appliedenergistics2_rocky_large.json + appliedenergistics2_huge_rocky.json.
